statement: A process's shadow reports and status are written under an id no earlier process used, whatever cosec.authorization.shadow.instance-id is set to, so a restart never replaces an earlier process's cumulative report or erases a CANDIDATE_ERROR it recorded.
guards: spring-boot:ShadowInstanceIdTest#a configured id is a prefix, with a suffix new at every start
spring-boot:ShadowInstanceIdTest#a restart with the same configured id keeps the earlier report
